column4: Paul Ginsparg, arXiv founder, says arXiv ("AR-kive") — Aspen Physics talk
column5: I'll start out — as Ethan mentioned — with arXiv, which has become the standard way of communicating information in physics.

column5: My goal with mise is for it to be one polyglot interface that no matter what your product's written in, no matter how many languages, ecosystems it has — you just have one common way to set it up.
